name: Stock Check
description: Check current stock of an item by name or SKU.
sql_template:
SELECT sku, name, qty, location, reorder_level, unit_price
FROM inventory
WHERE org_id = $1
  AND ($2::text IS NULL OR name ILIKE $2 OR sku ILIKE $2)
ORDER BY name
LIMIT 50

business_glossary.SKU: Unique stock keeping unit code identifying an item
business_glossary.stock: Quantity of an item currently available in inventory
business_glossary.low stock: Items whose quantity is below their own reorder level
business_glossary.reorder level: Minimum quantity below which the item should be restocked

llm_system_prompt: Checks stock from the inventory table. If the user names an item or SKU, show matches (fuzzy). If no item is given (e.g. menu tap or "stock check"), show ALL inventory items with their current quantities and reorder levels. Never ask which item when none was given — run with NULL. intent_key: check_stock
command_description: Full inventory stock status, or any item by name/SKU

name: Aging Report
description: Full aging analysis of all outstanding/overdue invoices, colour-coded by risk band (0-30 / 31-90 / 90+ days), delivered as a PDF automatically.
sql_template: SELECT i.invoice_number, c.name AS customer_name, c.city AS customer_city, c.gst_number AS customer_gstin, i.amount, i.due_date, i.status FROM invoices i JOIN customers c ON c.id = i.customer_id WHERE i.org_id = $1 AND i.status IN ('pending','overdue') AND ($2::text IS NULL OR c.name ILIKE $2) ORDER BY i.due_date ASC LIMIT 200

business_glossary.aging: how overdue each invoice is, grouped into risk bands
business_glossary.collection report: aging report used to prioritise recovery calls

llm_system_prompt: Runs a full aging analysis across ALL pending/overdue invoices, or one customer's if named. Tables: invoices JOIN customers. FLOW: (1) call query_database selecting invoice_number, customer_name, customer_city, customer_gstin, amount, due_date, status WHERE status IN (pending, overdue), optionally filtered by customer name via ILIKE; (2) IMMEDIATELY call generate_pdf with doc_type="report", title="Aging Report — Outstanding & Overdue Invoices" (or "Aging Report — <Customer>" if filtered), rows = the query result. This workflow ALWAYS produces a PDF as its primary output — do NOT wait for the user to type the word pdf, and do NOT return text-only. After sending the PDF, add one short line summarising total outstanding and the highest-risk bucket. Example inputs: "aging report" -> no filter; "Mehta Enterprises aging report" -> customer_name="Mehta Enterprises"; "overdue report pdf" -> no filter. Disambiguation: this is NOT a single-customer dues lookup (that stays text-only) — this is specifically the multi-bucket colour-coded aging PDF. intent_key: generate_aging_report

pdf_config.insight_focus: Call out the highest-risk (90+ day) customers first and recommend who to contact for collection today.

command_description: Full colour-coded aging analysis PDF of all outstanding dues

name: Pending Orders
description: List all orders that are not yet delivered or cancelled.
training_phrases: Show me all pending customer orders
sql_template:
SELECT order_number, customer_name, description, status,
            expected_delivery, estimated_amount, advance_paid
     FROM orders
     WHERE org_id = $1 AND status NOT IN ('delivered', 'cancelled')
     ORDER BY expected_delivery ASC NULLS LAST
     LIMIT 30

business_glossary.advance: Amount the customer has already paid against the order
business_glossary.pending order: An order whose status is not delivered and not cancelled
business_glossary.expected delivery: Date the order is promised to the customer

llm_system_prompt: This workflow lists pending orders from the orders table â€” every order whose status is not delivered or cancelled, soonest expected delivery first. It needs no input from the user. Example inputs: "show pending orders", "pending orders dikhao", "which orders are still open". Use the intent_key 'pending_orders' to trigger this workflow.
